final_resume.summary: Computer Science graduate (B.Tech, 2025) building full-stack web applications with Java, Spring Boot, and React. Demonstrated expertise in designing scalable REST APIs, implementing robust testing practices, and containerising applications with Docker. Seeking a Software Development Engineer II role to apply algorithmic problem-solving and distributed systems knowledge in a production environment.

projects.name: PaySplit - Group Expense Settlement
projects.description: Architected a Spring Boot REST API and React TypeScript frontend applying design patterns for expense settlement logic. Integrated Razorpay payment gateway with webhook handling for multiple transaction states. Implemented 40 JUnit tests achieving comprehensive code coverage and containerised the full stack with Docker for reproducible deployments.

projects.name: Campus Library Reservations
projects.description: Designed and built a Spring Boot service with MySQL schema for study room bookings, applying relational database design patterns. Piloted with 120 students over 2 weeks, eliminating double-booking conflicts through transactional integrity.

projects.name: Order Tracker Dashboard
projects.description: Developed a React and TypeScript dashboard consuming REST APIs to display real-time order status. Containerised with Docker Compose for local development consistency.

profile_improvement_tips: Gain 3+ years of professional software development experience at a company; this is a hard requirement for SDE II roles. Consider internships or entry-level SDE I positions first.
Deepen distributed systems knowledge through projects involving microservices, message queues (RabbitMQ, Kafka), or eventual consistency patterns.
Lead or actively participate in code reviews in a professional setting to demonstrate the 'Code Review' competency; document your feedback approach.
final_resume.growth_note: You are a strong fresher with solid full-stack fundamentals and excellent project execution. However, the SDE II role requires 3+ years of non-internship professional experience and 2+ years of system design/architecture work. Target SDE I or Graduate Engineer roles first; revisit SDE II after 2-3 years in industry.
